scope: Intel host MTF ownership, supported non-branch emulated completion, deferred scalar outputs, HLT activity admission and failure fencing

assumption_register.assumption: Host debugger step controls are separate from guest RFLAGS.TF and guest pending debug traps.
assumption_register.basis: Current target debugger ownership decision and Intel SDM MTF versus architectural TF semantics
assumption_register.dependent_result: MTF setter/getter and deferred guest debug delivery
assumption_register.stress_test: TF zero/one, repeated host enable/disable, capability errors and compensated/failed SDK writes
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Any host step transition accesses guest RFLAGS, changes a guest trap condition, or advances a guest instruction before its device effect
assumption_register.status: Confirmed by extracted production-method probes and portable production-policy/SDK-bridge tests; physical Intel execution unknown

assumption_register.assumption: The admitted intercepted instruction completion is a non-branch operation that does not explicitly write TF or RF.
assumption_register.basis: Current CPUID, represented MSR/CR8/XSETBV and scalar port/MMIO handlers; unsupported instruction/MSR profiles retain their existing boundaries; SDM 27.1.1 gives privilege/invalid-opcode/I/O-permission faults priority over the relevant instruction exits
assumption_register.dependent_result: RF clearing, TF/BTF pending BS generation, STI/MOV-SS expiry
assumption_register.stress_test: TF/RF/BTF combinations, retained pending causes, shadow masks, and each fallible completion stage
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A handler using this boundary branches, explicitly changes TF/RF, or reaches it on a guest fault or incomplete device transfer
assumption_register.status: Confirmed for inspected handlers and portable policy cases; hardware delivery and additional debug profiles unknown

assumption_register.assumption: The SDK capability query reports IA32_VMX_MISC activity-state capability bits as documented.
assumption_register.basis: Retained Apple SDK HV_VMX_CAP_MISC definition and Intel SDM Appendix A.6
assumption_register.dependent_result: Reject unsupported HLT activity before VMCS initialization; never enter an unsupported HLT state
assumption_register.stress_test: Every one-hot capability bit, HLT support zero/one and SDK query failure
assumption_register.falsification_probe: SDK bridge admits HLT without capability bit 6 or ignores a query failure
assumption_register.status: Confirmed for source/portable bridge; physical Intel SDK behavior unknown

assumption_register.assumption: An SDK write that reports failure may have mutated the control word.
assumption_register.basis: Conservative failure model; no undocumented SDK atomicity assumption
assumption_register.dependent_result: Verify exact compensation or fence future entry/capture; do not retry acknowledged device effects
assumption_register.stress_test: Failure before/after mutation, wrong readback, rollback write/read errors, prior enabled state and pending host completion
assumption_register.falsification_probe: An unverified control value is reused, or acknowledged output is emitted again after architectural commit failure
assumption_register.status: Stress-tested using actual portable policies and substituted SDK calls

assumption_register.assumption: Device acknowledgment marks successful dispatch; a failed callback does not imply device rollback.
assumption_register.basis: Existing VCpu completion contract and VMM dispatch ordering; arbitrary device callback failure semantics remain unknown
assumption_register.dependent_result: Retain unacknowledged output; fence after acknowledged completion failure
assumption_register.stress_test: Repeated pending output, duplicate acknowledgment, short/invalid descriptors, SDK failure after device commit
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A callback partially mutates a device and returns an error, followed by caller retry without device transaction recovery
assumption_register.status: CPU-side boundary confirmed; device-wide transactional retry remains an open full-goal gate

change_surface.backend: Intel HVF controls, emulated retirement, deferred output and HLT boundaries
change_surface.cpu_state: Guest TF preserved; pending BS generated; native pending output blocks architectural projection/capture
change_surface.debugger: Native host step state and error latching; existing software current-session restore binding unchanged
change_surface.device_runtime: Existing VMM dispatch/acknowledgment protocol consumed; bus implementations unchanged

bounded_scope.finding: Physical Intel VMX execution, guest event delivery and actual device effects have not been run on this Apple Silicon host.

Native private/checkpoint state, SDK thread-affinity and platform ownership are not fully qualified; input-request retry, IRQ/intercept coherence, additional MMIO/MSR/debug profiles and native retirement/clock accounting remain required.
Guest data/I/O breakpoint synthesis for emulated accesses and complete exception/error/reinjection frames remain open.
CPU-side retained output does not roll back arbitrary partially failed device callbacks.
MTF stops can follow event delivery or one REP iteration; no exact guest retirement credit is assigned.
One existing audit integration worktree is retained; no new worktree or subagent was created. Canonical build/scratch roots are removed after the group.

validation.state: complete for local scope; full native qualification incomplete
validation.root_library_reason: Runtime changes are Intel-native cfg; portable integration binaries execute the shared production policies. The Arm64 root library full run from the parent is not attributed to this source.
validation.C_API_reason: The C API constructs software cores; neither its executable behavior nor ABI layout changed. Workspace all-target checks/build/lint include C API compilation.
validation.workflow: git add -- <exact owned paths>; red -m --staged --run <same exact paths>

full_goal: A32-FP, C-STATE, C-SMP and C-HVF remain incomplete; no audit finding status is promoted by this bounded group.

quality_gates.assumptions: Recorded with stress tests and falsification probes; physical and device-recovery unknowns retained.
quality_gates.coverage: Current bounded semantic group maps to source, 18 new tests, complete affected binaries and three observed baseline/green probes. Full audit requirements remain open.
quality_gates.reproducibility: Pinned source/SDK hashes and exact commands retained; no dependency/lock/global-toolchain change.
quality_gates.edges: SDK compensation, failed/duplicate acknowledgments, guest TF/RF/BTF, pending traps and HLT capability/admission are explicit.
quality_gates.provenance: Local Intel primary passages and exact Apple headers verified; native execution not inferred from compilation.
quality_gates.bounded_scope: High/medium/low limits recorded without promoting global finding status.
quality_gates.ownership: Existing integration checkout only; exact path staging; source checksums frozen throughout compiler/test checks.
quality_gates.behavioral_evidence: 159 affected tests passed with no filters/ignored cases; five doctests were ignored and provide no behavioral evidence.
quality_gates.repository_consistency: Test target registered in Cargo, test registry and CI; SDK/source paths and documentation validated separately.
